title: Search System
description: Mechanics and endpoints of the worker search engine in Rozgar Connect

category.description: Filter workers matching this service category (exact match, case insensitive)

city.description: Filter workers located in this city (exact match, case insensitive)

area.description: Filter workers operating in this specific area/neighborhood (exact match, case insensitive)

search_logic: 1. Read query parameters category, city, area, sortBy.
2. Standardize string parameters by trimming white spaces and converting to lowercase.
3. Compile the MongoDB query object. Exclude any empty filters.
4. Query the User collection to fetch all active users (isActive: true). Extract their ObjectIds.
5. Add active users filter to query: only show worker profiles belonging to these active user IDs.
6. Apply sorting based on sortBy parameter.
7. Execute the query on the WorkerProfile collection, populating the 'userId' field to return the worker's name and email.
notes: The search parameters are mapped dynamically. If a parameter is not provided, the filter is completely bypassed.
If the database seed categories differ from defaults, the frontend fetches registered categories dynamically from '/api/v1/categories' and falls back to defaults if the API call fails.
